questiontext.text:
Calculate the gross and net reproduction rates from the data given below.

Number of women in age groups and number of female children born in one year
Age group Female population (\( ‘000 \), i.e. in thousands) Female births Survival rate
{@age_group1@}-{@age_group2@} {@fem_pop1@} {@fem_birth1@} {@surv_rate1@}
{@age_group2@}-{@age_group3@} {@fem_pop2@} {@fem_birth2@} {@surv_rate2@}
{@age_group3@}-{@age_group4@} {@fem_pop3@} {@fem_birth3@} {@surv_rate3@}
{@age_group4@}-{@age_group5@} {@fem_pop4@} {@fem_birth4@} {@surv_rate4@}
{@age_group5@}-{@age_group6@} {@fem_pop5@} {@fem_birth5@} {@surv_rate5@}
{@age_group6@}-{@age_group7@} {@fem_pop6@} {@fem_birth6@} {@surv_rate6@}

generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution

Gross Reproduction Rate \((GRR)\) i.e number of female children born to one woman as she passes through child bearing age, is sum of Age specific fertility rate per woman for child bearing ages. But, when data is in groups of \({@age@}\) years, it is equal to the sum of Age specific fertility rate per woman (female reproductive rate) for all groups \( \times {@age@}\) . Hence for computing gross reproduction rate we shall first compute Age specific fertility rate per woman.

The calculation are shown below

Age group Female population Female births Age specific fertility rate per woman (ASFR)
{@age_group1@}-{@age_group2@} {@fem_popt1@} {@fem_birth1@} \( \displaystyle \frac{{@fem_birth1@}}{{@fem_popt1@}}= {@ASFR_1@} \)
{@age_group2@}-{@age_group3@} {@fem_popt2@} {@fem_birth2@} \( \displaystyle \frac{{@fem_birth2@}}{{@fem_popt2@}}= {@ASFR_2@} \)
{@age_group3@}-{@age_group4@} {@fem_popt3@} {@fem_birth3@} \( \displaystyle \frac{{@fem_birth3@}}{{@fem_popt3@}}= {@ASFR_3@} \)
{@age_group4@}-{@age_group5@} {@fem_popt4@} {@fem_birth4@} \( \displaystyle \frac{{@fem_birth4@}}{{@fem_popt4@}}= {@ASFR_4@} \)
{@age_group5@}-{@age_group6@} {@fem_popt5@} {@fem_birth5@} \( \displaystyle \frac{{@fem_birth5@}}{{@fem_popt5@}}= {@ASFR_5@} \)
{@age_group6@}-{@age_group7@} {@fem_popt6@} {@fem_birth6@} \( \displaystyle \frac{{@fem_birth6@}}{{@fem_popt6@}}= {@ASFR_6@} \)
{@age_group7@}-{@age_group8@} {@fem_popt7@} {@fem_birth7@} \( \displaystyle \frac{{@fem_birth7@}}{{@fem_popt7@}}= {@ASFR_7@} \)
\( \displaystyle \sum ASFR ={@sum_ASFR@}\)

\(GRR=\sum (ASFR \times {@age@})={@sum_ASFR@} \times {@age@}={@ta1@}\)

Net reproduction rate- This is the number of female children surviving till their reproductive ages born to one woman as she passes through child bearing age. Thus it is the sum of Age specific fertility rate per woman for all ages \(\times\) survival rates. For data expressed in \({@age@}\) yearly age group, it is the sum of the Age specific fertility rate per woman for various groups \(\times\) survival rate \(\times {@age@}\).

The calculations are shown below

Age group Female population Female births Age specific fertility rate per woman (ASFR) Survival rate (S) \(ASFR \times S\)
{@age_group1@}-{@age_group2@} {@fem_popt1@} {@fem_birth1@} \( {@ASFR_1@} \) {@surv_rate1@} {@ASFR_s1@}
{@age_group2@}-{@age_group3@} {@fem_popt2@} {@fem_birth2@} \( {@ASFR_2@} \) {@surv_rate2@} {@ASFR_s2@}
{@age_group3@}-{@age_group4@} {@fem_popt3@} {@fem_birth3@} \( {@ASFR_3@} \) {@surv_rate3@} {@ASFR_s3@}
{@age_group4@}-{@age_group5@} {@fem_popt4@} {@fem_birth4@} \( {@ASFR_4@} \) {@surv_rate4@} {@ASFR_s4@}
{@age_group5@}-{@age_group6@} {@fem_popt5@} {@fem_birth5@} \( {@ASFR_5@} \) {@surv_rate5@} {@ASFR_s5@}
{@age_group6@}-{@age_group7@} {@fem_popt6@} {@fem_birth6@} \( {@ASFR_6@} \) {@surv_rate6@} {@ASFR_s6@}
{@age_group7@}-{@age_group8@} {@fem_popt7@} {@fem_birth7@} \( {@ASFR_7@} \) {@surv_rate7@} {@ASFR_s7@}
\( \displaystyle \sum (ASFR \times S)={@sum_ASFR_s@}\)

Therefore the Net reproduction rate \(\textbf{(NRR)}=\sum (ASFR \times S)\times {@age@}={@ta2@} \)
